servo_calibration: unknown; 270 degree total travel does not locate CAD neutral in electrical range
servo_variant: MG90 family, exact model and loaded speed unknown
contact_model: Fixed world XY sole-reference during stance; actual complete sole hull minimum Z is enforced. Contact migrates on the faceted rocking sole; material-point slip is reported separately.

provenance.link_lengths_and_frames: current live rig plus saved 24/38 transfer; measured
provenance.COM: assumed body-fixed datum, configurable; no masses
provenance.joint_bounds: Provisional numerical envelope, not physical stops. Part009 theta lower envelope expanded from -70 to -115 degrees for the requested rear reach; linkage closure and sampled mesh intersections checked separately.
provenance.shell_clearance: check approximate intersections separately; no dynamics
provenance.stride_limit: 100 percent retains the corrected 92 mm planted sweep and 30 mm rear bias. Motion rate independently retimes the shared trajectory. Ramped stride plans each touchdown from future stance travel; all branches and sole contacts require regenerated validation.

h_Part002.sign: positive right-hand rotation about local X

alpha_Part006.axis: Negative local Y of mechanism frame for increasing alpha

theta_Part005.axis: Negative local Y of mechanism frame for increasing theta

joint_conventions.provenance: Measured rig transforms and driver expressions, verified against evaluated Blender poses; electrical horn index not calibrated

configuration_owner: Edit this JSON and regenerate. Default preview is four uninterrupted 100 percent cycles. Blender properties describe the bake.
control_law: p=stride_percent/100; stance_sweep=92*p mm; cycle_advance=stance_sweep/0.7; cycle_frequency=motion_rate/1.8 Hz; speed=cycle_advance*cycle_frequency. Rear bias=(30/92)*predicted body travel during each stance; only future footholds move when stride changes.
